def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            p=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and grid[p[0]][p[1]]!=0 and p not in seen:
              seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
        top=min(y for y,x in cells); bot=max(y for y,x in cells); left=min(x for y,x in cells); right=max(x for y,x in cells)
        layers=[]; boxes=[]
        while top<=bot and left<=right:
          border=[grid[y][x] for y in range(top,bot+1) for x in range(left,right+1) if y in (top,bot) or x in (left,right)]
          if not border or len(set(border))!=1: break
          color=border[0]; layers.append(color); boxes.append((top,bot,left,right))
          top+=1; bot-=1; left+=1; right-=1
        if len(layers)>1:
          for k,box in enumerate(boxes):
            t,b,l,rr=box; old=layers[k]; new=layers[-1-k]
            for y in range(t,b+1):
              for x in range(l,rr+1):
                if grid[y][x]==old: out[y][x]=new
    return out
PY
